title: fincore 0041 weekly governance metrics
description: 7-day rolling governance metrics for iteration 0041. One file per week under .github/governance/0041/metrics/. Metric definitions are normative; weekly files must instantiate exactly these keys. An empty or unobservable week records null, never 0.

data_sources.description: Commands or API endpoints used, e.g. 'gh pr list --repo cloudQuant/fincore --state all --limit 200 --json number,createdAt'. Raw payloads stay out of the repository.

pr_count_new.definition: Pull requests opened in the window (any base branch).

first_response_p50_hours.definition: Median hours from PR open to first comment/review by someone other than the author.

first_substantive_review_p50_hours.definition: Median hours from PR open to first review that is an approval, request-changes, or a code-level comment by a non-author.

merge_cycle_p50_hours.definition: Median hours from open to merge, merged PRs only.

ci_failure_rate.definition: Failed check-run conclusions / total completed check-runs on PR heads in the window.

ci_flake_rate.definition: Re-run-passed-without-change events / total failed check-runs on PR heads in the window.

r2_pr_ratio.definition: PRs classified R2 / total implementation PRs in the window, per scripts/ci/classify_pr_risk.py output plus maintainer overrides.

r2_evidence_completeness_rate.definition: R2 PRs with compat/oracle/property evidence declared and linked / total R2 PRs in the window.

target_branch_misroute_count.definition: PRs whose base branch contradicted the D0 decision table and required retargeting before merge.

bypass_count.definition: Admin bypass events on protected branches (Ruleset bypass list), each requiring a linked issue with reason.

d3_exception_open_count.definition: Open D3 single-maintainer exceptions at window end (label governance-exception, expiry <= 30 days).

required_check_unexplained_pending_count.definition: PRs waiting indefinitely on a required check that never reported, at window end.

empty_baseline_instance.window_note: Baseline only; no observation window has closed yet.
